The assessed claim is instead the exact multivariate inverse-Gaussian attainable cone, singular-defect mean-range condition, rate threshold and noncommuting impossibility example. Closely related original full text and targeted literature and research-record searches were compared; no source was found stating or implying all of this classification. value.rationale: The prescribed full Gaussian steady state from random resetting is a motivated physical inverse-control task. The theorem classifies all finite-dimensional covariances/means and all admissible positive reset rates, specifies the unique distribution, and reveals a sharp anisotropic obstruction not captured by thermal covariance order. Both the sharp rate and the impossibility at every rate have direct design/feasibility interpretations; this is more than a small forward-moment exercise.
